narrative.details:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
narrative.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
narrative.offerRewardText: An interesting collection. These should work well enough!Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
narrative.requestItemsText: What did you find? Anything interesting?

mentionedItems.name: Shiny Silver Coin
tooltip: Use: Toss the lucky coin into the water to increase your Fishing Skill by 30 for 30 min.
